verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents a public JSON API at formulae.brew.sh that lists `brew info --json` output for all homebrew-core formulae and homebrew-cask casks. That API is read-only metadata, though. Actually driving installs, upgrades and taps goes through the scriptable CLI documented in the manpage, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. missing for 10: a programmatic API for driving actions (install/upgrade/uninstall), a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), in-depth API reference docs beyond the formula/cask listing endpoint, independent corroboration of API use by agents.
